units.source_text: 然而，一想起叶子在这家客栈里，不知为什么，岛村对找驹子也就有点拘束了。

en.t: Yet when he thought of Yoko being in this inn, Shimamura somehow felt a little constrained about looking for Komako.

units.source_text: 尽管驹子是爱他的，但他自己有一种空虚感，总把她的爱情看作是一种美的徒劳。

en.t: Although Komako loved him, he carried an emptiness of his own and always saw her love as a beautiful futility.

units.source_text: 即使那样，驹子对生存的渴望反而像赤裸的肌肤一样，触到了他的身上。

en.t: Even so, Komako's hunger to go on living touched him all the more, like bare skin against his body.

units.source_text: 他可怜驹子，也可怜自己。

en.t: He pitied Komako, and he pitied himself as well.

units.source_text: 他似乎觉得叶子的慧眼放射出一种像是看透这种情况的光芒。

en.t: He seemed to feel that Yoko's clear eyes gave off a light that could see through this state of things.

units.source_text: 他也被这个女子所吸引了。

en.t: He was drawn to this woman too.
